name: none
pros: Cannot be poisoned. There is nothing to write to.
Every run is reproducible from its inputs alone.
No storage, no keys, no eviction, no staleness.
cons: Identical work is redone in full every time.
A run that stops loses everything it had done.
pick_this_when: Runs are cheap, or inputs never repeat.
You need every run to be independently reproducible.
avoid_when: Runs are expensive and inputs repeat.

evidence.note: control arm; the only one with nothing to poison
